==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a group meeting. We are discussing an upcoming mission. A lot of the pilots feel really confident that we'll succeed.

We are all shown what the targets will look like. One resembles a skeletal dragon with glowing red eyes. The other resembles a metallic red dragon.

I try to warn the pilots that we've never faced anything like this before. The pilots scoff at my warning. They are already talking about plans for a book they'll write once they finish the mission.
